definitions.reference: Each actual native triangle at t=0; the opened rest geometry already has curved/oblique construction-grid axes.
definitions.principal_stretches: Singular values of the 3x2 triangle deformation gradient in an orthonormal rest tangent basis. Rotation/bending of an undeformed triangle alone leaves both equal to 1; principal maximum minus 1 is maximum local continuum line extension, not independently calibrated yarn strain.
definitions.directional_ratios: Current/reference norm of each triangle's derivative along panel material_x/height, or reconstructed strip width/centerline parameter. These are construction-direction proxies. Real warp/weft yarn orientations are not declared; no measured warp/weft split is claimed.
definitions.shear: Signed current-minus-rest angle between the two construction tangent vectors, in degrees. This subtracts the opened rest grid's initial obliquity. Reported extrema maximize absolute change while retaining sign; a shear angle is not a percent stretch.
definitions.UV: Texture uv=(projected rest X/width, rest Z/.5) is not a textile material coordinate chart and is deliberately not used for strain directions.
definitions.area_weighting: Quantiles and area fractions use actual native triangle rest area; no current-area mass redistribution.
definitions.motion: Group material centroid with constant reference-area lumped weights, minus measured left TCP translation, in world axes. Finite differences are interval-average saved-frame velocities. The internal RMS removes centroid translation, not rotation. These are forced motion/contact responses, not restitution or damping identification.
definitions.phase_boundary: Both adjacent phase summaries include their common endpoint; peak witness phase_at_time uses the next phase at a shared boundary.

limitations: Full per-triangle metrics exist only at saved frames (at most about50ms apart), so group maxima may miss inter-frame peaks; per-step soft summaries only retain the existing edge maximum, not principal/directional strain.
There is no measured warp/weft orientation, yarn constitutive response, hysteresis, or damping calibration. Construction axes are useful reproducible proxies only.

Single flat triangular elements do not resolve within-element wrinkles. In-plane apparent compression/shear can coexist with unresolved buckling; do not interpret it as fiber compression without a calibrated model.
All metrics are relative to the pre-opened native rest, not an experimentally flat stress-free woven sheet.
Observed final settling, peak velocity, or stretch cannot by itself identify friction, elastic modulus, energy loss or coefficient of restitution.
This baseline leaves the successful motion, all materials, assets, source, config and acceptance gates untouched; it is not a new simulation or physical success claim.

native_completion_readiness.scope: Finalization readiness only; reported task status is not independently recertified here.

comparison_scope: Same rest, faces, sampling, formulas and four groups. Compare phase labels and their own actual endpoints, not equal wall time. Identical commands do not imply identical dynamic loads; material effects are not isolated from changed contact/drape response. This is not a new physical-task audit.
